LOCKED_NARRATIVE: At the OOF checkpoint the instance-dependent policy beats the best flat threshold by 4.97% of policy profit (dev estimate) — ABOVE the pre-registered 1-3% plausibility band. The decomposition explains why without any parameter change: the cash t*(x) band (0.03-0.11) straddles the densest region of the calibrated PD distribution, so 13.4% of cash applicants are decided differently, and revolving's 0.175 threshold differs sharply from the flat 0.095 for 9.5% of the book. Term-driven variation contributes ~5x the revolving contribution, as the spec anticipated. The gain remains free — same model, same calibration, zero runtime cost — and the framework is what scales when LGD/EAD models and risk-based pricing get richer. The vs-0.5 number (naive baseline) is never a substitute for this comparison. Narrative locked at the OOF checkpoint, before the holdout run; no cost parameter was or will be revised; the holdout fills in the quoted number, whatever it is.
audit: independent numpy recompute matched to the euro; decomposition consistent with spec expectation (term-driven >> revolving)
